_comment: Example --avoidable-data file. 'spells' is the master list of spell ids tagged as avoidable (stand-in-fire / easily-dodged mechanics); 'dungeons' is optional metadata mapping a dungeon_idx (matching mdt_data.json) to the subset of tagged spells relevant to that dungeon. We ship the format + this one example, not a full spell database -- extend it yourself, or with a community-maintained file.

spells.name: Fel Detonation
spells.note: Murder Row (Felwyrm) -- AOE ground effect, easily sidestepped
